question: Lokapavani and Bhavani are tributaries of the River ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cauvery.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One of the five rivers that flow through the Mandya district is the **Lokapavani**. One of the tributaries of the **Cauvery River,** this is a perennial river.
 
• It has its source in **Honakare** and travels through the slopes of **Arighatta**. Near **Srirangapatna**, it merges with the **Cauvery**.
 
• The **Nilgiri hills of the Western Ghats** are the source of the **Bhavani River**.
 
• After that, it flows back towards **Tamil Nadu** through **Kerala's Silent Valley National Park**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the Erode district of Tamil Nadu, the Bhavanisagar Dam is located on the Bhavani River.
 
• The dam is among the greatest earthen dams on the planet.
 
• Many people come to this holy location to take a dip in the waters of the Sangam point of the** Lokapavani and Cauvery **with other tributaries of the **Cauvery Hemavati.**
 
• One of Kerala's three rivers that run eastward is the **Bhavani River.**
